summary: Container apps in the one-click installer: Ghost, Nextcloud, Uptime Kuma, n8n, Gitea and Plausible Analytics CE install on a private network with companion databases, loopback-only ports, a proxied HTTPS site and a health check. New typed agent verbs create containers under agent-side guards (KD-040). Migration 0010 is additive: app_installs.app_port, unique per server. Nothing is dropped.
